coverage.en: 112 distinct public sitemap rows (66 in 2026 and 46 in 2025), June 1, 2025 through November 15, 2026. All 112 official post URLs recovered; 72 post pages returned results from the reader; 40 were listed links but not independently openable in the public reader. A page resolving does not mean its lesson or file is public. The Posts and Collections index pages rendered navigation only; two collection landing pages and three additional public short companion posts were verified separately and excluded from the 112-post count. No login, private attachment copying or downloads.
